records.jp: ……白井さん？　みんな、どうしたの？
records.en_original: ...Shirai? What's going on, everyone?
records.en_auxiliary: ...Shirai? What's going on, everyone?
records.en: ...Shirai-san? What's going on, everyone?

records.jp: 人の顔を集団でガン見して、超感じ悪いんだけど……<CR>でも、ここは心を広く持っていかないとだよね！
records.en_original: It's super unsettling to have everyone staring me like this... But I have to keep an open heart and hear them out!
records.en_auxiliary: It's super unsettling to have everyone staring me like this... But I have to keep an open heart and hear them out!
records.en: Having a whole group stare at my face feels really unpleasant...<CR>But I need to keep an open mind here!

records.jp: だから口に出てるって……<CR>って、そんなつっこみはさておき
records.en_original: And once again, you're thinking out loud... But that's not important right now.
records.en_auxiliary: And once again, you're thinking out loud... But that's not important right now.
records.en: Like I said, you're saying it out loud...<CR>But setting that aside.

records.jp: 史緒、現実を突きつけるようで悪いんだけど、<CR>たぶんすぐにわかることだから聞くよ
records.en_original: Fumio, this may sound harsh, but it's reality, and you'd find out soon enough on your own anyway.
records.en_auxiliary: Fumio, this may sound harsh, but it's reality, and you'd find out soon enough on your own anyway.
records.en: Fumio, sorry to be blunt,<CR>but you'll find out soon enough anyway, so I have to ask.

records.jp: 史緒が言う「理想の音色が出るピアノ」って<CR>どこにあったの？
records.en_original: Where is that better piano you were talking about? The one that had the sound you wanted.
records.en_auxiliary: Where is that better piano you were talking about? The one that had the sound you wanted.
records.en: Where was the "piano that produces your ideal sound"<CR>you mentioned?

records.jp: ん？　保健室？
records.en_original: Hm? The nurse's office.
records.en_auxiliary: Hm? The nurse's office?
records.en: Hm? The nurse's office.

records.jp: って、あれ？<CR>美術室？　職員室？
records.en_original: Wait, huh? <CR>The art room, maybe? The Teachers' Lounge?
records.en_auxiliary: Wait, huh? The art room, maybe? The teachers' office?
records.en: Wait, huh? <CR>The art room, maybe? The Teachers' Lounge?

records.jp: え、あれれ？
records.en_original: No, what?
records.en_auxiliary: No, what?
records.en: H-Huh?

records.jp: 本当は史緒だってわかってるんじゃない？<CR>そんなピアノなかったって
records.en_original: You understand now, don't you? That piano you're talking about didn't exist.
records.en_auxiliary: You understand now, don't you? That piano you're talking about didn't exist.
records.en: Deep down, don't you already know?<CR>That there was no such piano.

records.jp: っ、そんなはずない！<CR>私はちゃんと覚えてる！　音色も、指の感触も！
records.en_original: ...No, that's not true! I remember it so clearly! The sound, the way my fingers felt on the keys...!
records.en_auxiliary: No, that's not true! I remember it so clearly! The sound, the way my fingers felt on the keys...!
records.en: Th-That's impossible!<CR>I remember it clearly—the sound and the feel beneath my fingers!

records.jp: でも――
records.en_original: But--
records.en_auxiliary: But—
records.en: But--

records.jp: もういい！　そんなに言うなら、探してくるから！
records.en_original: I'll show you! If you don't believe me, I'll go look for it!
records.en_auxiliary: I'll show you! If you don't believe me, I'll go look for it!
records.en: I'll show you! If you don't believe me, I'll go look for it!

records.jp: 口挟まなかったけど、これでよかったの？
records.en_original: I didn't want to interrupt, but are you sure about this?
records.en_auxiliary: I didn't want to interrupt, but are you sure about this?
records.en: I didn't interrupt, but...was that really okay?

records.jp: うん
records.en_original: I am.
records.en_auxiliary: I am.
records.en: Yeah.

records.jp: たぶん、あの子の見たピアノってフラグメントの産物だよね
records.en_original: I assume that her dream piano was a product of her Fragment.
records.en_auxiliary: I assume that her dream piano was a product of her Fragment.
records.en: I think the piano she saw was created by her Fragment.

records.jp: プレッシャーと完璧主義のぶつかり合いで生まれた理想の幻像
records.en_original: An idealized delusion that manifested where her perfectionism collided with the pressure she's feeling.
records.en_auxiliary: An idealized delusion that manifested when her perfectionism collided with the pressure she's feeling.
records.en: An idealized illusion born from the clash between pressure and perfectionism.

records.jp: そこまでの力を持つフラグメントってのも珍しいけど、<CR>少し異常なくらい理想の音のイメージに囚われてたってことかな
records.en_original: It's very rare to find a Fragment with that much power, but she was almost abnormally obsessed with getting that sound.
records.en_auxiliary: It's very rare to find a Fragment with that much power, but she was abnormally obsessed with getting the sound she was imagining.
records.en: It's rare for a Fragment to have that much power,<CR>but I guess she was fixated on her ideal sound to an almost abnormal degree.

records.jp: うん。だからまずは現実を直視してもらわないと。<CR>今のままじゃ話が始まらない
records.en_original: She was. But now she needs to face reality head on. And we can help her.
records.en_auxiliary: She was. But now she needs to face reality head on. And we can help her.
records.en: Yeah. First, she has to face reality.<CR>We can't even begin while she's like this.

records.jp: ちょっと荒療治じゃない？
records.en_original: Isn't this a little drastic?
records.en_auxiliary: Isn't this a little drastic?
records.en: Isn't this a little drastic?

records.jp: 大丈夫、きっと上手くいくから
records.en_original: It will be fine. The truth will reveal itself in the end.
records.en_auxiliary: Don't worry, it will be fine.
records.en: It'll be okay. I'm sure it will work.

records.jp: どうだった……って、様子を見ればわかるけど
records.en_original: Judging from the look on your face, I don't think I have to ask you if you found it...
records.en_auxiliary: Judging from the look on your face, I don't think I have to ask you if you found it...
records.en: How did it go...? Though I can tell just by looking at you.

records.jp: なかった……本当に夢、だったの？
records.en_original: It wasn't anywhere... Was it really just a dream?
records.en_auxiliary: It wasn't anywhere... Was it really just a dream?
records.en: It wasn't anywhere... Was it really just a dream?

records.jp: もうだめ。私……発表会には……
records.en_original: I'm done for. The recital... I can't...!
records.en_auxiliary: I'm done for. The recital... I can't...!
records.en: It's hopeless. I...the recital...

records.jp: 違うよ！
records.en_original: You're wrong!
records.en_auxiliary: You're wrong!
records.en: No!

records.jp: ……白井、さん？
records.en_original: ...Uh, what?
records.en_auxiliary: ...Huh?
records.en: ...Shirai...san?

records.jp: 私もずっとバレエをしていたから、<CR>史緒の気持ちはわかる
records.en_original: I've done ballet all my life, so I know just where you're coming from.
records.en_auxiliary: I've done ballet all my life, so I know just where you're coming from.
records.en: I did ballet for years,<CR>so I understand how you feel, Fumio.

records.jp: ううん、もちろん、ピアノの音色の違いなんてわからないし、<CR>そもそも私は史緒の演奏をいいと思ってたけど
records.en_original: And even if I can't tell the sound of one piano from another, I know that your performance was great!
records.en_auxiliary: And even if I can't tell the sound of one piano from another, I know that your performance was great!
records.en: Of course, I can't tell the difference between piano tones,<CR>and I thought your playing sounded good from the start.

records.jp: 今の史緒は「表現者」としての心構えを見失っている！
records.en_original: But right now, you've lost sight of what it really means to express yourself on stage!
records.en_auxiliary: But right now, you've lost sight of what it really means to express yourself on stage!
records.en: Right now, you've lost sight of the mindset a performer needs!

records.jp: 表現者としての……心構え？
records.en_original: What do you mean?
records.en_auxiliary: What do you mean?
records.en: The mindset...a performer needs?

records.jp: 確かに、自分の理想を追求していって、<CR>それをお客さんに披露するやり方もあるよ
records.en_original: Think about it. As a performer, you try find the truth in your own ideals, then present that to the audience.
records.en_auxiliary: Think about it. As a performer, you chase after your own ideals, then present that to the audience.
records.en: Sure, you can pursue your own ideal<CR>and present it to the audience.

records.jp: でも今の史緒は理想に振り回されてるだけ。<CR>「伝える」ことができていないよ
records.en_original: But you're so focused on getting the exact details of your ideals right, that you're not able to convey anything.
records.en_auxiliary: But you're so focused on getting the exact details of your ideals right, that you're not able to convey anything.
records.en: But right now, you're letting that ideal control you.<CR>You're not actually conveying anything.

records.jp: 大事なのはあくまでお客さんがどう感じるかなんだから<CR>演技する側が満足してるかなんて、どうでもいい
records.en_original: When you're on the stage, the important thing is how the audience feels. How the performer feels is secondary.
records.en_auxiliary: When you're on the stage, the important thing is how the audience feels. How the performer feels is secondary.
records.en: What matters is how the audience feels.<CR>Whether the performer is satisfied doesn't matter.

records.jp: あなたの演奏が何を表現していて、<CR>お客さんがその演奏から何を受け取るか、それが重要なの
records.en_original: What you express through your performance, and how the audience accepts and interprets it, is everything.
records.en_auxiliary: What you express through your performance and what the audience gets out of it is everything.
records.en: What your performance expresses,<CR>and what the audience takes away from it—that is what matters.

records.jp: わかる？　表現者は自分を殺さなきゃいけない
records.en_original: You get it? The performer needs kill her sense of self.
records.en_auxiliary: You get it? Performers need to kill their sense of self.
records.en: Do you understand? A performer has to erase herself.

records.jp: ……自分を、殺す？
records.en_original: ...Kill herself?
records.en_auxiliary: Kill...my sense of self?
records.en: ...Erase myself?

records.jp: あなたが感じるんじゃなく、聴いてる人に感じさせていかないと
records.en_original: You can't be the only one who gets something out of your performance. Your listeners need to feel something, too.
records.en_auxiliary: You can't be the only one who gets something out of your performance. Your listeners need to feel something, too.
records.en: It's not about what you feel. You have to make your listeners feel something.

records.jp: でも、そんな冷たい演奏じゃ聞いている人の心は動かせなくて
records.en_original: But my performance is so...cold. There's no way it will move anyone's heart.
records.en_auxiliary: But there's no way I'll move anyone's heart with a cold performance like that.
records.en: But a performance that cold won't move anyone's heart.

records.jp: 私は史緒の奏でる音、すごくきれいだと思ったよ
records.en_original: You moved me. I thought it was bautiful.
records.en_auxiliary: You moved me. I thought it was beautiful.
records.en: I thought your playing sounded beautiful, Fumio.

records.jp: あの演奏をした時、史緒は何を考えていたの？
records.en_original: What was on your mind when I heard you playing?
records.en_auxiliary: What was on your mind when I heard you playing?
records.en: What were you thinking about when you played that piece?

records.jp: あの時は……弾くのに夢中で
records.en_original: Right then...I was just engrossed in playing the piano.
records.en_auxiliary: Right then...I was just engrossed in playing the piano.
records.en: Then...I was completely absorbed in playing.

records.jp: そう、何も考えてなかった。<CR>でも私の心は動かせたよ
records.en_original: That's right. You weren't thinking about anything, just playing. And you still moved me.
records.en_auxiliary: That's right. You weren't thinking about anything, just playing. And you still moved me.
records.en: Right. You weren't thinking about anything.<CR>But you still moved my heart.

records.jp: そう……か
records.en_original: I...see.
records.en_auxiliary: I...see.
records.en: I...see.

records.jp: 白井さん……うん。<CR>何かちょっとだけ糸口が見えた気がする
records.en_original: ...Yeah. I think you've finally helped me see a sliver of light at the end of this tunnel.
records.en_auxiliary: Shirai, I... Yeah, I think you've finally helped me see a sliver of light at the end of this tunnel.
records.en: Shirai-san... Yeah.<CR>I feel like I can finally see a small way forward.

records.jp: 史緒は実力があるんだから、あとは心の持ちようだよ
records.en_original: Fumio, you know you have the skill. The rest will come from your heart, not your mind.
records.en_auxiliary: Fumio, you know you have the skill. The rest just has to come from your heart.
records.en: You already have the skill, Fumio. The rest depends on your state of mind.

records.jp: じゃあヒナちゃんこれ
records.en_original: Here, Hina.
records.en_auxiliary: Here, Hina.
records.en: Here, Hina-chan.

records.jp: うん。史緒……これ、つけておいて
records.en_original: Right. Fumio, would you mind wearing this?
records.en_auxiliary: Right. Fumio, would you mind wearing this?
records.en: Yeah. Fumio...wear this.

records.jp: 指輪？
records.en_original: A ring?
records.en_auxiliary: A ring?
records.en: A ring?

records.jp: お守りみたいなものだよ
records.en_original: It's like a lucky charm.
records.en_auxiliary: It's like a lucky charm.
records.en: It's like a lucky charm.

records.jp: ふーん
records.en_original: Hmm...
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm...
records.en: Hmm...

records.jp: 正直デザイン的には趣味じゃないけど、ここで断ると<CR>角が立ちそうだから受け取っておくかぁ。あえては言わないけど
records.en_original: That ring's REALLY not my style, but if I don't accept it, <CR>things might get awkward. Just gotta smile and nod, I guess.
records.en_auxiliary: That ring's really not my style, but if I don't accept it, things might get awkward. Not that I can say that, though.
records.en: Honestly, the design isn't really my taste, but refusing now<CR>would make things awkward, so I'll take it. I won't say that out loud, though.

records.jp: （ちょっとグーでパンチしてもいいかな？　この子）
records.en_original: (Can I give this girl a good punch? Just once?)
records.en_auxiliary: (Can I give this girl a good punch? Just once?)
records.en: (Can I give this girl a good punch? Just once?)

records.jp: うん、ぴったり！　『できる限り』大事にするね！
records.en_original: Look, it's a perfect fit! I'll be "sure" to keep it "safe and sound."
records.en_auxiliary: Look, it's a perfect fit! I'll be "sure" to keep it "safe and sound."
records.en: Yeah, it fits perfectly! I'll treasure it 'as much as possible'!

records.jp: ま、まあ……そう言ってもらえるとありがたいかな
records.en_original: Th-Thanks, that fills me with confidence.
records.en_auxiliary: Th-thanks, that fills me with confidence.
records.en: W-Well...I'm glad to hear that, I guess.

records.jp: じゃあ必要なことはだいたいわかったし、おいとまするね。<CR>早く音楽室で練習しなきゃ
records.en_original: Well, now that I know what I've got to do, I'll take my leave. I better get to the music room and start practicing!
records.en_auxiliary: Well, now that I know what I've got to do, I'll take my leave. I better get to the music room and start practicing!
records.en: Well, I understand most of what I need now, so I'll take my leave.<CR>I need to hurry to the music room and practice.

records.jp: じゃーねー！
records.en_original: Laaaater!
records.en_auxiliary: Laaaater!
records.en: Laaaater!

records.jp: ヒナちゃん、あの子の気持ち、<CR>本当に理解できたの？
records.en_original: Hina, are you really sure you got what she was feeling?
records.en_auxiliary: Hina, are you really sure you understood what she was feeling?
records.en: Hina-chan, are you really sure<CR>you understood how that girl felt?

records.jp: ……裏表はない、と思う
records.en_original: ...I think so. Unless she's a really good liar.
records.en_auxiliary: ...I think so. Unless she's a really good liar.
records.en: ...I think she was being sincere.

records.jp: たぶん……
records.en_original: Probably...
records.en_auxiliary: Probably...
records.en: Probably...
